card.name: Plant sterols in cholesterol-lowering foods
card.fires_on: Linking words and punctuation right after foods or terms about plant sterols, stanols and phytochemicals, such as 'enriched with', 'drinks with', or 'phytosterols ('. Seen in diet advice on lowering cholesterol.

modes.label: Fortified foods
modes.description: The word 'with' after a food that has plant sterols added.
modes.example: Margarines, orange juice and yogurt drinks<< with>> added plant sterols can help reduce LDL

modes.label: Inside sterol terms
modes.description: Punctuation or word pieces inside or next to plant stanol and phytochemical terms.
modes.example: Foods with added plant stanols<<:>> stanols are natural phytochemicals
